Based on the codebase pattern (mirroring `levelup`/`shop` routes), here's the full file list for a "Rest at the Inn" feature (pay gold → restore HP to full):

## Worker (backend)

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `worker/src/types/index.ts` | Add `RestBody { sessionId, characterId }` interface; add a cost constant, e.g. `REST_COST_GOLD = 5` (or per-level formula). |
| `worker/src/routes/rest.ts` *(new)* | New `restRoutes = new Hono()`. `POST /api/rest`: load character via `getCharacter`, validate `character.gold >= REST_COST_GOLD` (400 if not), validate `character.hp < character.max_hp` (optional 400 "already at full HP"), then call `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: character.max_hp, gold: character.gold - REST_COST_GOLD })`, insert an `adventure_log` row (actor `'system'`, e.g. `"${name} rests at the inn and recovers to full health."`), return `{ success, updatedCharacter }`. |
| `worker/src/services/character.ts` | No new function strictly required — reuse existing `getCharacter`/`updateCharacter`. (Optionally add a `restAtInn()` helper here instead of inline logic in the route, following the `levelUp()` pattern.) |
| `worker/src/index.ts` | Import `restRoutes` and add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes);`. |

## Frontend (Angular)

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` | Add a `RestResponse { success: boolean; updatedCharacter: Character }` interface (mirrors `ActionResponse` shape) and a `REST_COST_GOLD` constant matching the Worker's value for display. |
| `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `restAtInn(sessionId: string, characterId: string): Observable<RestResponse>` calling `POST ${API_BASE}/api/rest`. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` | Add `restLoading` signal and a `restAtInn()` method calling `api.restAtInn(...)`, updating `charSvc.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)` and pushing a system log entry (same pattern as `levelUp()`). |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html` | Add a "Rest at the Inn (💰N gp)" button, disabled when `charSvc.character().gold < REST_COST_GOLD` or `hp === max_hp`, calling `(click)="restAtInn()"`. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/character-sheet/character-sheet.component.html`/`.ts` *(optional)* | Alternative/additional placement for the rest button next to HP/gold display, since this component already renders `hp`, `max_hp`, and `gold`. |

No DB migration is needed since `characters.hp` and `characters.gold` columns already exist.
